mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MSG (MSG_ID, SENDER_EMPNO, RECEIVER_EMPNO, TITLE, CONTENT, SENT_AT, PARENT_MSG_ID) VALUES (MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{senderEmpno}, #{receiverEmpno}, #{title}, #{content}, SYSDATE + 9/24, #{parentMsgId})
INSERT INTO MSG_FILE (FILE_ID, MSG_ID, FILE_NAME, S3_URL, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE) VALUES (MSG_FILE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{msgId}, #{fileName}, #{s3Url}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType})
mapper.select: SELECT m.MSG_ID, m.SENDER_EMPNO, m.RECEIVER_EMPNO, s.ENAME AS SENDER_NAME, r.ENAME AS RECEIVER_NAME, s.PHOTO_URL AS SENDER_PHOTO, r.PHOTO_URL AS RECEIVER_PHOTO, m.TITLE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(m.CONTENT, 100, 1) AS CONTENT, TO_CHAR(m.SENT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT, TO_CHAR(m.READ_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS READ_AT, m.SENDER_DELETED, m.RECV_DELETED, m.PARENT_MSG_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MSG_FILE f WHERE f.MSG_ID = m.MSG_ID) AS FILE_COUNT FROM MSG m LEFT JOIN EMP s ON s.EMPNO = m.SENDER_EMPNO LEFT JOIN EMP r ON r.EMPNO = m.RECEIVER_EMPNO WHERE m.RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{empno} AND m.RECV_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY m.MSG_ID DESC

SELECT m.MSG_ID, m.SENDER_EMPNO, m.RECEIVER_EMPNO, s.ENAME AS SENDER_NAME, r.ENAME AS RECEIVER_NAME, s.PHOTO_URL AS SENDER_PHOTO, r.PHOTO_URL AS RECEIVER_PHOTO, m.TITLE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(m.CONTENT, 100, 1) AS CONTENT, TO_CHAR(m.SENT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT, TO_CHAR(m.READ_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS READ_AT, m.SENDER_DELETED, m.RECV_DELETED, m.PARENT_MSG_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MSG_FILE f WHERE f.MSG_ID = m.MSG_ID) AS FILE_COUNT FROM MSG m LEFT JOIN EMP s ON s.EMPNO = m.SENDER_EMPNO LEFT JOIN EMP r ON r.EMPNO = m.RECEIVER_EMPNO WHERE m.SENDER_EMPNO = #{empno} AND m.SENDER_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY m.MSG_ID DESC

SELECT m.MSG_ID, m.SENDER_EMPNO, m.RECEIVER_EMPNO, s.ENAME AS SENDER_NAME, r.ENAME AS RECEIVER_NAME, s.PHOTO_URL AS SENDER_PHOTO, r.PHOTO_URL AS RECEIVER_PHOTO, m.TITLE, m.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(m.SENT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT, TO_CHAR(m.READ_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS READ_AT, m.SENDER_DELETED, m.RECV_DELETED, m.PARENT_MSG_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MSG_FILE f WHERE f.MSG_ID = m.MSG_ID) AS FILE_COUNT FROM MSG m LEFT JOIN EMP s ON s.EMPNO = m.SENDER_EMPNO LEFT JOIN EMP r ON r.EMPNO = m.RECEIVER_EMPNO WHERE m.MSG_ID = #{msgId}
SELECT FILE_ID, MSG_ID, FILE_NAME, S3_URL, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE FROM MSG_FILE WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} ORDER BY FILE_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE MSG SET RECV_DELETED = 1 WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{empno}
UPDATE MSG SET SENDER_DELETED = 1 WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND SENDER_EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MSG WHERE RECEIVER_EMPNO = #{empno} AND RECV_DELETED = 0 AND READ_AT IS NULL
SELECT 0 AS MSG_ID, EMPNO AS SENDER_EMPNO, ENAME AS SENDER_NAME FROM EMP
